messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English showing two adult friends naturally finishing one topic and moving into another without an abrupt transition. The scene should feel continuous and unforced. Use dialogue, small actions, and a little environmental detail. Do not summarize the transition for the reader. Let the change happen through the characters.

“So that’s three emails and no answer.”

Jordan folded her arms. “Maybe they didn’t get the first two.”

Alex raised an eyebrow. “You sent all three in the same hour.”

“I was being efficient.”

“You were panicking.”

“There’s a difference.”

“Not today.”

Jordan laughed and reached for her drink. The ice had melted enough that the straw rattled against the lid.

“Whatever,” she said. “I’ll deal with it tomorrow.”

“Good.”

“I hate that you’re right.”

“You’ll survive.”

Jordan looked out the window for a moment. “Speaking of surviving, are you still coming Saturday?”

“To your terrible movie night?”

“Yes.”

“I haven’t agreed to that.”

“You said yes yesterday.”

“I said maybe.”

“You said, ‘Fine.’”

“That was under pressure.”

Jordan smiled. “You’re coming.”

Alex sighed. “Apparently.”

“Bring snacks.”

“Now you’re negotiating.”

“Obviously.”

Alex picked up her cup. “Fine. But I’m choosing the first movie.”

Jordan nodded. “Deal.”

“And if it’s terrible, I’m blaming you.”

“Also fair.”
